ap_releases.init_architecture: Pure Native Linux /init -> switch_root -> systemd / OpenRC / procd PID 1
ap_releases.notes: Current active Universal AP. Supports multi-storage boot_target.conf (internal sda24, MicroSD image, MicroSD raw partition), universal init discovery (systemd, OpenRC, OpenWrt procd), cgroup v1 hierarchy mount for Docker/HAOS/LXC, 9 Calliope DSP firmwares, ConfigFS RNDIS+ACM, s8_usb_agentd, and s8_dp_daemon.

ap_releases.init_architecture: Pure Native Linux /init -> switch_root -> systemd PID 1
ap_releases.notes: First Pure Native Linux switch_root PID 1 release. Superseded by v2.0.2 which added multi-storage boot_target.conf, OpenWrt/Alpine/HAOS cgroup v1 mounts, and embedded /etc/s8-ap-version.
Golden legacy fallback baseline using Samsung GCC 4.9 CFP kernel and Android init.rc trigger. Kept permanently in releases/history/ as emergency fallback.

FAILED (Finding 115): Compiled with modern GCC 13 while CONFIG_RKP_CFP=y was enabled. Exynos 8895 EL2 TrustZone micro-Hypervisor aborted cold boot at instruction 0 (0.43A quiescent current). Fixed by enforcing CONFIG_RKP_CFP=n.

FAILED (Rule 17): Bind-mounting /system_root/vendor/firmware over /etc/firmware in permissive.sh shadowed the 9 Calliope DSP firmwares, causing ABOX IPC timeout and s3c2410_wdt 15s watchdog panic at second 12.

hw_pack_releases.notes: OS-agnostic s8ctl banner ([s8ctl v1.0.3]), verified cross-distro deployment across OpenWrt procd, Alpine BusyBox init, Kali systemd, Debian 12 systemd, Home Assistant OS 18.4 systemd, SteamOS 3.6 Holo systemd, and Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS Desktop.

Added DisplayPort cursor 0xFF alpha fix + ensure_usb_host_mode() in exynos_dp_bridge, hotplug USB/BT mouse & keyboard forwarder s8_input_bridge + s8-input-bridge.service, USB-LAN Dongle Auto-DHCP in s8-usb-gadget.sh, and universal init support (systemd, OpenRC, OpenWrt procd, HAOS).
Intermediate build with updated DisplayPort and input bridge prebuilts.
Initial standalone hardware package release (PMIC 1500mA, Wi-Fi BCM4361, Calliope ALSA, exynos_dp_bridge, s8_button_daemon, s8ctl). Does not include s8_input_bridge or cursor alpha fix.
